token = apis.phone.login(username='8506051563', password=[x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password'])['access_token']
spam_num='3654328626'

def count_remaining():
    texts=[]; page_index=0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=token, phone_number=spam_num, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-created_at')
        if not page:
            break
        texts.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    voices=[]; page_index=0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_voice_messages(access_token=token, phone_number=spam_num, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-created_at')
        if not page:
            break
        voices.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    texts_from_spam=[t for t in texts if t['sender']['phone_number']==spam_num]
    voices_from_spam=[v for v in voices if v['sender']['phone_number']==spam_num]
    return len(texts_from_spam), len(voices_from_spam), texts_from_spam, voices_from_spam

rt, rv, tlist, vlist = count_remaining()
print('Remaining from spam sender:', spam_num)

print('Text IDs remaining:', [t['text_message_id'] for t in tlist])
